name: io.github.Enreign/pagerunner
description: Chrome browser automation MCP server for AI agents — drives real Chrome with your profiles

features.session_management: Multiple concurrent sessions with Chrome profiles
features.navigation: Smart waiting with selectors, URL patterns, or fixed delays
features.content_extraction: Sanitized text, screenshots, and JavaScript evaluation
features.interactions: Click, type, fill, select, scroll elements
features.state_persistence: Snapshots for cookies/localStorage and tab state
features.pii_anonymization: Tokenize or redact PII with named profiles
features.security: SSRF protection, prompt injection mitigation, domain allowlisting
features.stealth_mode: Masks automation signals with human-like delays
features.daemon_mode: Shared state across multiple MCP clients
